Question Choices: Fill: Three vertices of a rectangle are $(0, 0)$, $(7, 0)$ and $(7, 3)$. Write the fourth vertex. (__, __)
Hints: Copy the displacement of the opposite side.
Solution: The move from the second corner (7,0) to the third (7,3) is (0,3). Apply that move to (0,0): (0+(0),0+(3))=(0,3). Opposite sides have equal displacement.
